source: Project Gutenberg eBook #78050 (Principia Mathematica, Vol. I), "Alphabetical list of propositions referred to by names"; the formula is the transcription's TeX
note: PM gives one name to several numbers (Syll, Transp, Simp), so a name is never a key on its own: the key is the number.

names.name: Comp
names.printed: \(\vdash\colon\ldotp p \supset q. p \supset r. \supset \colon p. \supset .q. r\)

names.name: Exp
names.printed: \(\vdash\colon\ldotp p. q. \supset . r: \supset \colon p.  \supset . q \supset r\)

names.name: Fact
names.printed: \(\vdash\colon\ldotp p \supset q. \supset \colon p. r. \supset . q. r\)

names.name: Imp
names.printed: \(\vdash\colon\ldotp p. \supset . q \supset r \colon \supset \colon p. q. \supset . r\)

names.name: Sum
names.printed: \(\vdash\colon\ldotp q \supset r. \supset \colon p \lor q. \supset . p \lor r\)

names.name: Syll
names.printed: \(\vdash\colon\ldotp q \supset r. \supset \colon p \supset q. \supset . p \supset r\)

names.name: Syll
names.printed: \(\vdash\colon\ldotp p \supset q. \supset \colon q \supset r. \supset . p \supset r\)

names.name: Syll
names.printed: \(\vdash : p \supset q. q \supset r. \supset . p \supset r\)
